purpose.summary: Spring Boot REST API that evaluates a JSON rule grammar (all/any/not groups and comparison/existence conditions) against arbitrary JSON input data and returns a boolean result.

components.name: Application bootstrap
components.purpose: Starts the Spring Boot application context.

components.name: REST API layer
components.purpose: Exposes the /evaluate HTTP endpoint, validates requests, and maps errors to HTTP responses.

components.name: Rule evaluation engine
components.purpose: Parses and evaluates the JSON rule grammar (groups all/any/not, conditions eq/ne/lt/lte/gt/gte/between/in/contains/regex/exists/not_exists/isNull/isNotNull) against a data map.

components.name: Scratch Main class
components.purpose: IDE-generated demo Hello World class, unrelated to and not wired into the Spring Boot application.

entrypoints.name: POST /api/v1/rule-engine/evaluate
entrypoints.invocation: HTTP POST with {data, rule} JSON body

entrypoints.name: Main.main
entrypoints.invocation: java org.example.Main (not part of the Spring Boot application)

standard_commands.purpose: Build the application JAR without running tests
Run the application locally on port 8080
Run the unit and integration test suite

risks: No authentication or authorization on the /evaluate endpoint (ev-016)
regex operator compiles user-supplied patterns with no ReDoS guard (ev-017)
README documents 422 for validation errors but code returns 400 (ev-006)
No CI/CD, Dockerfile, or deployment manifests present (ev-020)
unknowns: Whether/where this service is deployed and what runtime configuration it uses
Whether Main.java is intentional or leftover scaffolding
